title: UPPS-P Gambling Text Benchmark
description: This repository provides a frozen synthetic corpus of 62,895 English social-media-style monologues associated with 2,000 synthetic user profiles, conditioned on five intended UPPS-P impulsivity facets: Negative Urgency, Positive Urgency, Lack of Premeditation, Lack of Perseverance, and Sensation Seeking. The corpus includes gambling/addiction and generic contexts. The repository contains user-disjoint data partitions, experimental configurations, saved predictions, statistical analysis outputs, evaluation artifacts, and model-specific pooling diagnostics for nine pretrained language encoders. These materials support the study entitled 'Beyond the Big Five: Benchmarking Pretrained Language Encoders for Predicting Intended UPPS-P Facet Levels from Synthetic Gambling-Related Text'. The intended facet-level labels represent synthetic generation conditions rather than independently measured psychological traits. The dataset is intended for methodological research and benchmarking, not clinical diagnosis or psychological profiling of real individuals.
